text:
Dental Planet Clinic Onnut is a really good dental place. The clinic itself is a bit smaller, located just off On Nut, but it’s easy to access and convenient.

I found the fees reasonable, little higher than a dental place inside a private hospital might charge. The service was very good—quick, professional, and efficient. It was also helpful that the staff could speak a little English, which made the first steps and communication much smoother for me at this point when I’m still just learning Thai.

The clinic is clean, well maintained, and overall gave me a positive experience. Definitely a solid choice if you’re looking for dental care around On Nut.
